description: Container object holding an array of synchronized script cues matched against video or audio timestamps.

cues.description: Ordered list of script synchronization cues, sorted chronologically by startTime.

items.description: A single synchronized cue linking a script excerpt with a playback timecode window.

id.description: Unique identifier for the cue (e.g. 'cue_001', 'cue_002'). Must be unique across all cues.

type.description: Semantic classification of the cue. Options: 'dialogue' (spoken lines / speech), 'action' (scene description, character actions, physical movement), 'camera' (camera directions / movements like PAN, TILT, POV), 'shot' (shot framing like CLOSE UP, WIDE SHOT), 'audio' (sound effects, SFX, music cues), 'vfx' (visual effects, CGI, on-screen graphics), 'transition' (cuts, dissolve, scene transitions), 'environment' (ambient setting, background atmosphere, lighting). Defaults to 'dialogue' if unspecified.

speaker.description: The uppercase name of the character speaking (e.g. 'MARK', 'ELENA'). Must be null if the cue is not dialogue or if no specific character is speaking.

selectedText.description: The exact, verbatim, contiguous substring copied directly from the script (e.g. text inside <ScriptText>...</ScriptText>). Can be a single word, a phrase, or a full sentence. Must match the script text identically without paraphrasing, summarizing, or altering casing or punctuation.

startTime.description: Playback start time in total elapsed seconds as a decimal number (e.g. 83.5 for 1 minute 23.5 seconds, NOT 123.5). IMPORTANT: Convert all timecodes (mm:ss or hh:mm:ss) into total seconds (minutes * 60 + seconds). Never output colon-stripped numbers. Must be >= 0 and strictly less than endTime.

endTime.description: Playback end time in total elapsed seconds as a decimal number (e.g. 87.2 for 1 minute 27.2 seconds, NOT 127.2). IMPORTANT: Convert all timecodes (mm:ss or hh:mm:ss) into total seconds (minutes * 60 + seconds). Must be strictly greater than startTime.
